asset.name: AssetViewHelper
asset.documentation:
The `<vite:asset>` ViewHelper embeds all JavaScript and CSS belonging to the
specified vite `entry` using TYPO3's AssetCollector API. It automatically
switches between Vite's development server and production rendering
(manifest.json) based on the extension's configuration.

Assets are embedded with the following defaults:

* Scripts are embedded as JavaScript modules using `<script type="module">`
  at the end of the document
* CSS files use `<link rel="stylesheet">` in the `<head>`
* Imported JavaScript modules are preloaded automatically using
  `<link rel="modulepreload">`
* Referenced images and fonts are preloaded automatically using
  `<link rel="preload">`

These defaults can be configured separately for CSS and script assets by nesting
`<vite:asset.script> <https://docs.typo3.org/permalink/praetorius/vite-asset-collector:viewhelper-asset-script>`_
and/or
`<vite:asset.css> <https://docs.typo3.org/permalink/praetorius/vite-asset-collector:viewhelper-asset-css>`_
inside `<vite:asset>` (see examples below).

Example: Basic usage
====================

..  code-block:: html

    <vite:asset entry="EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/JavaScript/Main.entry.js" />

Example: Inlining CSS
=====================

..  code-block:: html

    <vite:asset entry="EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/JavaScript/Main.entry.js">
        <vite:asset.css inline="{true}" />
    </vite:asset>

Example: Disable automatic preloading
=====================================

..  code-block:: html

    <vite:asset entry="EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/JavaScript/Main.entry.js">
        <vite:asset.script preloadImports="{false}" />
        <vite:asset.css preloadFonts="{false}" preloadImages="{false}" />
    </vite:asset>

Example: Media query for CSS
============================

..  code-block:: html

    <vite:asset entry="EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/Css/Print.entry.css">
        <vite:asset.css media="print" />
    </vite:asset>

manifest.name: manifest
manifest.description: Path to your manifest.json file. If omitted, default manifest from extension configuration will be used instead.

entry.name: entry
entry.description: Identifier of the desired vite entrypoint; this is the value specified as "input" in the vite configuration file. Can be omitted if manifest file exists and only one entrypoint is present.

csp.name: csp
csp.description: Whether to collect a CSP hash value for this asset (default: true for external files, false for inline)

useNonce.name: useNonce
useNonce.description: Deprecated, use csp instead. (Whether to use the global nonce value)

scriptTagAttributes.name: scriptTagAttributes
scriptTagAttributes.description: Deprecated, use <vite:asset.script> instead. (Additional HTML attributes for script tags)

addCss.name: addCss
addCss.description: Deprecated, use <vite:asset.css> instead. (If set to "false", CSS files associated with the entry point won't be added to the asset collector)

inlineCss.name: inlineCss
inlineCss.description: Deprecated, use <vite:asset.css> instead. (If set to "true", CSS will be added as inline <style> tag.)

cssTagAttributes.name: cssTagAttributes
cssTagAttributes.description: Deprecated, use <vite:asset.css> instead. (Additional HTML attributes for css link tags.)

priority.name: priority
priority.description: Deprecated, use <vite:asset.css> for CSS and <vite:asset.script> for scripts instead. (Include assets before other assets in HTML)

asset.css.name: Asset\CssViewHelper
asset.css.documentation:
The `<vite:asset.css>` ViewHelper allows to customize the embedding of
CSS assets with the `<vite:asset>` ViewHelper. It can only be used as a
direct child element of `<vite:asset>`.

See `<vite:asset> <https://docs.typo3.org/permalink/praetorius/vite-asset-collector:viewhelper-asset>`_
for more examples.

Example: Inlining CSS
=====================

..  code-block:: html

    <vite:asset entry="EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/JavaScript/Main.entry.js">
        <vite:asset.css inline="{true}" />
    </vite:asset>

priority.name: priority
priority.description: Set to "false" if the CSS should be loaded with lower priority.

inline.name: inline
inline.description: Set to "true" if the CSS should be embedded inline with a <style> tag.

preloadFonts.name: preloadFonts
preloadFonts.description: Set to "false" if referenced font files shouldn not be preloaded automatically.

preloadImages.name: preloadImages
preloadImages.description: Set to "false" if referenced image files should not be preloaded automatically.

ignore.name: ignore
ignore.description: Set to "true" if the CSS should not be embedded at all.

disabled.name: disabled
disabled.description: Set to "true" if the <link> tag should be marked as disabled.

additionalAttributes.name: additionalAttributes
additionalAttributes.description: Additional attributes to be added to the <link>/<style> tag.

asset.script.name: Asset\ScriptViewHelper
asset.script.documentation:
The `<vite:asset.script>` ViewHelper allows to customize the embedding of
script assets with the `<vite:asset>` ViewHelper. It can only be used as a
direct child element of `<vite:asset>`.

See `<vite:asset> <https://docs.typo3.org/permalink/praetorius/vite-asset-collector:viewhelper-asset>`_
for more examples.

Example: Disable preloading of imports
======================================

..  code-block:: html

    <vite:asset entry="EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/JavaScript/Main.entry.js">
        <vite:asset.script preloadImports="{false}" />
    </vite:asset>

priority.name: priority
priority.description: Set to "true" if the script should be embedded in the <head> of the document.

preloadImports.name: preloadImports
preloadImports.description: Set to "false" if imported scripts should not be preloaded automatically.

ignore.name: ignore
ignore.description: Set to "true" if the script should not be embedded at all.

module.name: module
module.description: Set to "false" if the script should be embedded as a classic script instead of a JavaScript module (e. g. for non-ESM build output).

async.name: async
async.description: Set to "true" if the script should be executed as soon as it is loaded. Can be used for JavaScript modules and classic scripts.

defer.name: defer
defer.description: Set to "true" if the classic script should be executed after the document has been parsed. JavaScript modules are always deferred, so this can only be used with module="{false}".

nomodule.name: nomodule
nomodule.description: Set to "true" if the classic script should be used as an alternative to a JavaScript module. Can only be used with module="{false}".

additionalAttributes.name: additionalAttributes
additionalAttributes.description: Additional attributes to be added to the <script> tag.

uri.name: UriViewHelper
uri.documentation:
The `<vite:uri>` ViewHelper extracts the uri to one specific asset file from a vite
manifest file. If the dev server is used, the dev server uri to the resource is returned.

Example
=======

This can be used to preload certain assets in the HTML `<head>` tag.

..  note::
    The extension covers this particular use case by default since v2. However, it
    still illustrates the usage of `<vite:uri>`.

Solution for TYPO3 v14+
-----------------------

..  code-block:: html
    <f:page.headerData>
        <link
            rel="preload"
            href="{vite:uri(file: 'EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/Fonts/webfont.woff2')}"
            as="font"
            type="font/woff2"
            crossorigin
        />
    </f:page.headerData>

Solution for TYPO3 v13
----------------------

First, add a Fluid template to your TypoScript setup, for example:

..  code-block:: typoscript

    page.headerData {
        10 = FLUIDTEMPLATE
        10 {
            file = EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/Templates/HeaderData.html
        }
    }

Then create the HeaderData template:

..  code-block:: html
    :caption: EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/Templates/HeaderData.html

    <link
        rel="preload"
        href="{vite:uri(file: 'EXT:sitepackage/Resources/Private/Fonts/webfont.woff2')}"
        as="font"
        type="font/woff2"
        crossorigin
    />

manifest.name: manifest
manifest.description: Path to vite manifest file; if omitted, default manifest from extension configuration will be used instead

file.name: file
file.description: Identifier of the desired asset file for which a uri should be generated
